shortDescription: Manage individual Traffic Shaper Limiter Queues.

options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: aqm
options.description: The Active Queue Management (AQM) algorithm to use for this queue. AQM is the intelligent drop of network packets inside the queue, when it becomes full or gets close to becoming full, with the goal of reducing network congestion.

options.name: buckets
options.description: The limiter queue's bucket size (slots).

options.name: description
options.description: The verbose description for this limiter queue.

options.name: ecn
options.description: Enable or disable ECN. ECN sets a reserved TCP flag when the queue is nearing or exceeding capacity. Not all AQMs or schedulers support this.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Enables or disables this limiter queue.

options.name: lookup_fields
options.description: The list of fields to use when looking up existing resources. This should be a list of field names that uniquely identify a resource.

options.name: mask
options.description: If `source` or `destination` slots is chosen a dynamic pipe with the bandwidth, delay, packet loss and queue size given above will be created for each source/destination IP address encountered, respectively. This makes it possible to easily specify bandwidth limits per host or subnet.

options.name: maskbits
options.description: The IPv4 mask bits to use when determine the scope of the dynamic pipe for IPv4 traffic.

options.name: maskbitsv6
options.description: The IPv6 mask bits to use when determine the scope of the dynamic pipe for IPv4 traffic.

options.name: name
options.description: The unique name for this limiter queue.

options.name: param_codel_interval
options.description: The value for the CoDel interval parameter.

options.name: param_codel_target
options.description: The value for the CoDel target parameter.

options.name: param_gred_max_p
options.description: The value for the GRED max_p parameter.

options.name: param_gred_max_th
options.description: The value for the GRED max_th parameter.

options.name: param_gred_min_th
options.description: The value for the GRED min_th parameter.

options.name: param_gred_w_q
options.description: The value for the GRED w_q parameter.

options.name: param_pie_alpha
options.description: The value for the PIE alpha parameter.

options.name: param_pie_beta
options.description: The value for the PIE beta parameter.

options.name: param_pie_max_burst
options.description: The value for the PIE max_burst parameter.

options.name: param_pie_max_ecnth
options.description: The value for the PIE ecnth parameter.

options.name: param_pie_target
options.description: The value for the PIE target parameter.

options.name: param_pie_tupdate
options.description: The value for the PIE tupdate parameter.

options.name: param_red_max_p
options.description: The value for the RED max_p parameter.

options.name: param_red_max_th
options.description: The value for the RED max_th parameter.

options.name: param_red_min_th
options.description: The value for the RED min_th parameter.

options.name: param_red_w_q
options.description: The value for the RED w_q parameter.

options.name: parent_lookup_query
options.description: A dictionary of query parameters used to look up the parent Traffic Shaper Limiter. This should contain field name/value pairs that uniquely identify the parent object this resource is nested under.

options.name: pie_capdrop
options.description: Enable or disable cap drop adjustment.

options.name: pie_onoff
options.description: Enable or disable turning PIE on and off depending on queue load.

options.name: pie_pderand
options.description: Enable or disable drop probability de-randomisation.

options.name: pie_qdelay
options.description: Set queue delay type to timestamps (true) or departure rate estimation (false).

options.name: plr
options.description: The amount of packet loss (in percentage) added to traffic passing through this limiter queue.

options.name: qlimit
options.description: The length of the limiter's queue which the scheduler and AQM are responsible for. Set to `null` to assume default.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should be present or absent.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.

options.name: weight
options.description: The share of the parent limiter this queue gets.
